created_after.description: Return only the runs created at or after this time, in ISO 8601 format.

created_before.description: Return only the runs created before this time, in ISO 8601 format.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

preset_id.description: Return only the runs that used this preset.

repository.description: Return runs whose repository contains this text.

status.description:
Return only the runs with this status. A status filter covers the newest 1,000 runs that are active, for `queued` and `running`, or that have no agent at work, for `idle` and `done`.

* `queued` - Queued
* `running` - Running
* `idle` - Idle
* `done` - Done

tag.description: Return only the runs that have this tag.
